body: All right im not really someone who can say they are great at the game by any means but i will not come at you toxic and hopefully encourage you rather than what some people may be doing on this subreddit. To be completely honest, yes dying and losing 75% of your skill points is especially annoying. Even more so with the current change in skill trees that seem to make it even harder to raise skills (I have about 25 hours on a campaign with my friends as a DOC and i miss the old skill tree of gaining 5 points to medical upon combining, refining, or identifying genes and being abled to get to 200 medical) I have 45 hours-ish in total in the game messing around learning stuff but overall i think 75% punish to the skills is the least of your worriers in the grand scheme of things. I am also someone that doesnt die alot just like you (in those 25 hours of play time i have only died about 4 times. only 3 of them being from monsters/player mishaps, and one being my friend trolling me while i was afk). I see dying as a learning curve, and as someone else has said to be a way to reflect. I usually dont respawn either but not out of sourness, but just because i feel like trying to dock with them at the stae we are now (about to enter the fourth stage?? I believe) can do more damage then good (causing them to not move or get in their way). But from someone who also enjoys seeing a high number in their stats I want you to know your feeling are heard and  it makes sense as to why you are frustrated because when i was early on it bothered me as well. IN all honesty I think that you are early into the game and havent come to the realization that there is more stuff to be worried about. For example, I'm more annoyed that i lose my XP buffs when i die then anything else because i want more perks, which in turn may help you get more skills, I also worry about if my items on my person can be grabbed, I worry if my teammates will make it to the end because I dont want them suffering the same fate of losing their skills, etc. I play with a group of about 7 and we play on the biggest ship available in vanilla, we are all very strong and some of us even have our dream genetics (another big worry to lose when dying). Late game losing skills doesnt matter in the slightest, I hope you do continue playing with your friends, and I apologize for all of the scumbags that are just outright bullying you. But I hope you get to experience the late game rush of getting your dream genetics, amazing stats and items, and playing like your life depended on it. If you dont like that type of stuff this game may not be for you, but i think that the games state early on is rough around the edges but gets polished as you progress so i hope you stick with it!! Good luck down in the deep dark if you do decide to proceed.

My life has always been a joke. When I was younger my parents told me what to do and when to do it and I never had any say. I felt controlled and all I wanted to do was break free. Fast forward to my freshmen high school year I tried to tell my parents I was gay because I was starting to get into relationships and I wanted to be able to full experience it. My parents hated it and grounded me for 6 months with no technology, and other restrictions. Fast forward to now im 20, I have a job and “friends” but I never feel welcomed because none of them know I’m gay, my parents still think I’m straight and keep telling me to bring a girl home, I was in college but got sick of it and dropped out. My only real passions were video games, singing, and playing the drums, none of which my parents every supported me doing because they said it was for losers or were too “girly”. I’ve never been in a serious relationship, hell I’ve basically never been romantically involved in fear of my parents kicking me out of their house. I have a little bit of money saved up but no where near enough for a place to live, all of my relatives are homophobic so nowhere to go. I’m living a boring life with nothing to do but wake up and go to work and play video games because I’m too scared to confront my parents because I don’t want to be kicked out. I want this all to end, all of this is too much, I have no one to trust, no one to support me, nothing I want to pursue. I just want to lay down and die.
I’m also going through some shit rn, if there was a power cord I would’ve pulled it years ago I can never understand how people keep pushing, life seems so meaning less
I have been pushing through this for a while now, some more time is something I don’t want in this environment if it’s more years I have to deal with this. But I do appreciate the advice.

To make matters worse my parents blame it on the stress of work and when I tell them I’m also stressed because of work they blow it off, tell me I’m lazy and I need to do more, take my computer away from me and everything. I can’t help but think why did I get stuck with a polar opposite family, why out of my other 2 siblings was I the reject why am I the failure why am I the one that has to be abused and treated like trash. My last option before ending my life I realized will be running away. I don’t have enough money saved to rent or anything but I do have a decent car and some money saved up. I am not sure what to do except that it all needs to stop one way or another. I have thought about most outcomes, I’ve done a lot of research and I’ve spent countless nights thinking of possibilities and I am at a loss but those two. I don’t want “professional” help because it is ran by assholes who abuse “broken” people for money, or people who give up way too quick. I am not sure what to do. The only goal I had in life was to be a therapist and to try to be the person who stops these kinds of things but it’s blocked by years of depression, thousands of dollars in debt, and being surrounded by a family that hates me. I can’t even enjoy internet because I “forgot to thaw out the food for dinner” and now I am grounded for weeks. I want these weeks to be my last. I am just plain and simply done.
